$comment: ONE source of truth for every MCP server of 3GS_Master.
Render it everywhere with:  gs mcp-sync --apply --client all
pi profiles + ~/.workbuddy-ai/mcp.json + .cursor/mcp.json + .vscode/mcp.json
+ .mcp.json + opencode.json    -   the client list lives in mcp/clients.json
Never hand-edit pi-home-*/mcp.json, ~/.workbuddy-ai/mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json,
.vscode/mcp.json, .mcp.json or opencode.json for these servers - the next sync
overwrites them. Add a server HERE and it appears on every surface at once.
engines: which pi profile gets the server (threejs | godot | unity | roblox | any).
workbuddy.enabled: whether WorkBuddy loads it in every session. WorkBuddy has no
per-engine gating and cannot switch profiles inside a session - it loads whatever is
not marked disabled - so the RAG servers are on: a cloud model has no memory of the
pinned engine docs, the search tool IS its reference, and a session is not scoped to
one engine. The project servers (godot, unity-project, rbx-project) stay off: they
answer for data/active_project.txt and the 3GS launchers start them when a project is
actually in play. No server receives the active project through an env var - that
snapshot goes stale the moment the user switches projects, and every stack already
resolves the pointer file itself.
pi renders this `description` into the profile; WorkBuddy does not, so there the trigger
the model actually sees is each MCP tool's own docstring (tools/list). Both surfaces are
written imperatively - name the engine, list the tools, say when to call them - and both
keep the exact tool names, because that text is what makes a cloud model reach for the RAG
or the asset pipeline instead of answering from memory.

placeholders.{studio_mcp}: StudioMCP.exe of the installed Roblox Studio

threejs-rag.description: Three.js r186 knowledge base - tools: threejs_rag_search, threejs_rag_status. Hybrid search (dense + BM25, RRF-fused) over the pinned r186 API reference, the r186 source tree with JSDoc, addon sources, cookbook, rules and anti-patterns, plus whatever Three.js project is indexed as source=project. Call threejs_rag_search BEFORE answering a Three.js API question or writing Three.js code: the answer is the pinned r186 text, not a model's memory of the library. If threejs_rag_status reports embedding_server.status other than ok, the search is lexical-only - say so instead of trusting the ranking.

godot-rag.description: Godot 4.7 knowledge base - tools: godot_rag_search, godot_rag_status. Hybrid search (dense + BM25, RRF-fused) over the pinned official docs, cookbook, rules, anti-patterns, troubleshooting and external-asset notes, plus whatever Godot project is indexed as source=project. Call godot_rag_search BEFORE answering a Godot API question or writing GDScript: this repo targets 4.7, so a 3.x answer from memory is wrong here. godot_rag_status reports index size and embedder health.

godot.description: Godot project tools (narrow on purpose): read/write GDScript, scene create/add/remove node, project settings, headless lint, run/play/stop, plus the Godot RAG. Paths are sandboxed to the active project.

unity-rag.description: Unity 6000.3 knowledge base - tools: unity_rag_search, unity_rag_status. Hybrid search (dense + BM25, RRF-fused) over the pinned Manual, Scripting API, cookbook, rules, anti-patterns and troubleshooting, plus whatever Unity project is indexed as source=project. Call unity_rag_search BEFORE answering a Unity API question or writing C#: it is the pinned 6000.3 text, not a model's memory of an older Unity.

unity-project.description: Unity project tools: read/write C# and assets, validate (lint or full compile), run an editor method, read the live console. Project root comes from data\active_project.txt; a batch gate needs the editor at UNITY_EDITOR.

rbx-rag.description: Roblox knowledge base - tools: rbx_rag_search, rbx_rag_status. Hybrid search (dense + BM25, RRF-fused) over the Creator Hub guides, the Engine API Reference (one chunk per class member, with Security/Thread Safety tags), the Open Cloud reference, the curated Russian starter kit, the cookbook, troubleshooting and anti-patterns, plus the active project's Luau as source=project. Call rbx_rag_search BEFORE answering a Roblox platform question or writing Luau - platform facts come from the base, not from memory.

rbx-project.description: Roblox project tools on disk: project info, list/read/write/edit files (sandboxed to the project root, timestamped backups), Luau search, Luau lint (unbalanced end, deprecated globals, Instance.new parent, method case, server-only services in a client script), place inspection (.rbxlx -> services, class counts, scripts), Studio status and open_place. The live DataModel is the Studio MCP server's job, not this one.

roblox-studio.description: The built-in Roblox Studio MCP server (StudioMCP.exe, started by %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\mcp.bat over stdio - the exact launcher from create.roblox.com/docs/studio/mcp). It is the ONLY way to touch a live DataModel: script_read / multi_edit / script_search / script_grep, generate_mesh / generate_material / generate_procedural_model / wait_job_finished, search_asset / insert_asset / upload_image / store_image, search_game_tree / inspect_instance / subagent, execute_luau (Edit/Client/Server), get_studio_state / start_stop_play / get_console_output / screen_capture, character_navigation / user_keyboard_input / user_mouse_input, http_get / skill, and list_roblox_studios. Every call takes a studio_id - get it from list_roblox_studios, which matters when several Studio windows are open. Reports 0 tools until Studio is open with 'Enable Studio as MCP server' on (Assistant -> ... -> Manage MCP Servers); that is not a broken config.

assets.description: Local asset generation - the FIRST tier of ASSET-POLICY. Call one of these BEFORE downloading art or reaching for a cloud generator (ImageGen/VideoGen and any hosted API are not a route): text-to-image with z-image-turbo (:8687), background removal, image-to-3D (Pixal3D/TRELLIS.2 via ComfyUI :8188), whole-pack runs. Tools: asset_image, asset_edit, asset_remove_bg, asset_to_3d, asset_character, asset_generate_pack, assets_status. Use it whenever a task needs a texture, sprite, background, key art or a 3D model - even when the user did not say 'generate'. One asset_generate_pack call per pack, never one call per asset. The 7200 s timeout covers a pack of several 3D models - a legitimately long silence, do not retry it. For Roblox: generated images are decals/UI, generated meshes are imported through Studio's Asset Manager.
